package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// ListI18n lists available languages.
type ListI18n struct {
	I18n repository.I18nRepository
}

// Handle returns all i18n entries.
func (uc ListI18n) Handle(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.I18n, error) {
	return uc.I18n.List(ctx)
}
